ex: BARBELL POWER CLEAN at the catch position. The athlete is in a quarter-squat receiving position: barbell racked on the front of the shoulders/upper chest, elbows high and pointed forward, upper arms parallel to the floor, feet about shoulder width, knees bent and hips slightly back, chest upright. The bar rests on the deltoids with the grip relaxed/fingertips under the bar, wrists extended back. Side three-quarter view showing the racked bar, high elbows, bent knees, whole body and both feet flat.

BARBELL OVERHEAD SQUAT at the bottom position. The athlete holds a barbell locked out directly overhead with a wide snatch grip, arms fully extended and shoulders engaged. He sits in a deep squat: hips below knee level, knees tracking over the toes, torso nearly upright, chest up, feet flat about shoulder width. Front three-quarter view showing the overhead bar, straight arms, deep squat depth, whole body and both feet.

DUMBBELL PUSH PRESS at the locked-out overhead position. The athlete stands with knees just finishing the drive, both dumbbells pressed straight overhead, arms fully extended, palms facing forward. The dumbbells sit above the shoulders in line with the ears. Front three-quarter view showing both overhead dumbbells, locked elbows, the whole body and both feet flat.

SEATED DUMBBELL ARNOLD PRESS at the TOP of the press. The athlete sits on a bench with vertical back support, both dumbbells pressed overhead with arms fully extended and palms facing FORWARD (the rotated finish position). Feet flat on the floor. Slightly front three-quarter view showing both overhead dumbbells, the forward-facing palms, the backrest, whole body and both feet.

BATTLE ROPES mid-exercise with alternating waves. The athlete stands in an athletic half-squat, knees bent, torso upright, one hand raised to chest height and the other lowered, each hand gripping the end of a thick rope anchored to a heavy base in front of him. The two ropes show clear S-shaped waves traveling toward the anchor. Front three-quarter view showing both rope ends in his hands, the waves, the anchor point, whole body and both feet.

BACK EXTENSION on a 45-degree hyperextension (Roman chair) bench at the raised position. The athlete lies face-down over the angled hip pad with ankles secured under the foot rollers, body lifted so head-to-heels forms one straight line, arms crossed over the chest. Side view showing the hip pad, ankle rollers, the straight raised torso, whole body and feet anchored.

GLUTE-HAM RAISE on a GHD machine at the raised position. The athlete faces down on the machine with feet locked under the ankle pads against the footplate, thighs supported on the large rounded knee pad, torso lifted so the body forms a straight line from head to knees, arms crossed over the chest. Side view showing the footplate, ankle pads, knee pad, the straight raised torso and whole body.

PISTOL SQUAT near the bottom. The athlete balances on one leg in a deep single-leg squat, other leg extended straight forward roughly parallel to the floor, both arms reaching straight ahead for balance, torso slightly inclined forward but chest up. Side three-quarter view showing the bent supporting leg, the extended forward leg, outstretched arms, whole body and the planted foot.

WALL HANDSTAND PUSH-UP mid-descent. The athlete is upside-down in a handstand with heels resting against a plain gray studio wall behind him, arms bent about 90 degrees lowering the head toward the floor, body straight from wrists to heels. Side three-quarter view clearly showing the wall contact with the heels, bent elbows, the inverted straight body, both hands flat on the floor.

MUSCLE-UP on a horizontal pull-up bar at the TOP of the transition: the athlete's chest is above the bar, elbows bent and drawn back behind the body, shoulders over the bar, at the bottom-of-dip moment before pressing up. The bar is fixed between two upright posts. Front three-quarter view showing the high chest-over-bar position, the bar, both hands gripping it, whole body and both legs hanging.

BEAR CRAWL mid-stride. The athlete crawls forward on hands and toes with knees bent and hovering just off the floor, back flat like a tabletop; the right hand and left foot are forward while the left hand and right foot are back, clearly mid-step. Side three-quarter view showing the hovering knees, flat back, the alternating hand/foot positions, whole body, all four limbs.

MONSTER WALK with a resistance band looped around the ankles. The athlete stands in a quarter-squat with knees bent and slightly out, torso upright, mid side-step: one leg stepped out to the side against the band, the other leg about to follow. A thin colored resistance band clearly loops around both ankles under tension. Front three-quarter view showing the band around the ankles, the athletic stance, whole body and both feet.

KETTLEBELL WINDMILL at the hinged bottom position. The athlete stands with legs nearly straight and feet angled, right arm locked vertically overhead holding a kettlebell, eyes looking up at the bell, torso folded sideways to the left, left arm reaching down toward the inside of the left leg. Side three-quarter view showing the vertical overhead kettlebell arm, the sideways-hinged torso, both legs, whole body and both feet.

KETTLEBELL TURKISH GET-UP at the high-bridge moment. The athlete is on the floor: right foot planted flat driving the hips up into a bridge, right arm locked straight up holding a kettlebell overhead toward the ceiling, left arm posted on the floor for support, left leg sweeping underneath the body. Side three-quarter view showing the locked-out kettlebell overhead, the lifted hips, the posted left hand, both feet and the floor position.

DUMBBELL SIDE BEND at the leaned position. The athlete stands holding one dumbbell hanging at his right side with a straight arm, torso laterally bent to the right lowering the dumbbell down beside the thigh, left hand relaxed by the hip, spine straight in the frontal plane (pure lateral flex, no twist). Front three-quarter view showing the sideways lean, the hanging dumbbell, whole body and both feet flat.

BARBELL PALMS-UP WRIST CURL over a bench. The athlete sits on a bench seat facing forward with both forearms resting flat on the bench top, palms UP holding a light barbell with wrists hanging over the near edge, wrists curled up toward the body (contracted position). Side three-quarter view clearly showing the forearms on the bench, the barbell, the bent-up wrists, whole body and feet.

BARBELL PALMS-DOWN WRIST CURL over a bench. The athlete sits with both forearms resting on his thighs or the bench edge, palms DOWN gripping a light barbell, wrists extended upward (knuckles raised toward the ceiling). Side three-quarter view clearly showing the supported forearms, the barbell, the palms-down grip and raised knuckles, whole body and feet.

DUMBBELL ZOTTMAN CURL at the TOP of the curl with the rotated grip: both dumbbells curled to shoulder height with palms facing DOWN/AWAY from the body (pronated top position), elbows fixed by the ribs. Front three-quarter view showing both raised dumbbells, the downward-facing palms, elbows tight to the torso, whole body and both feet.

ASSISTED DIP on a Gravitron-style dip/pull-up assist machine at the lowered position. The athlete kneels with both shins on the padded knee platform, gripping the two dip handles at his sides, elbows bent so the upper arms are about parallel to the floor, torso upright. A weight stack tower is visible behind him. Side three-quarter view showing the knee platform under the shins, both handles, bent elbows, the stack, whole body.

ASSISTED PULL-UP on a Gravitron-style machine at the pulled-up position. The athlete stands on the machine's fold-down support platform/steps below an overhead pull-up bar, chin over the bar with elbows bent pulling down, feet supported by the platform, torso upright. A weight stack tower is visible behind. Front three-quarter view showing the overhead bar, both hands, the supported feet on the platform, the stack, whole body.

BAND-ASSISTED PULL-UP at the top position. The athlete hangs from a horizontal pull-up bar with chin over the bar, a thick loop resistance band stretched from the bar down under his feet/shins supporting him, elbows bent pulling down. Front three-quarter view showing the bar, both hands, the vertical band stretched under the feet, the band loop over the bar, whole body.

CABLE SINGLE-ARM TRICEPS KICKBACK at the extended position. The athlete stands hinged forward at the hips facing a low pulley, right hand holding a single cable handle with the upper arm parallel to the floor pinned by the ribs, forearm extended straight back so the arm is fully straightened behind him. The cable runs from the low pulley to the handle. Side view showing the forward hinge, straight extended arm, the cable path to the low pulley, whole body and both feet.

LYING LEG RAISE on a flat bench at the raised position. The athlete lies flat on his back on a long flat bench, hands under his hips, both legs straight and lifted together toward the ceiling near vertical, feet pointed. Side three-quarter view showing the flat bench, the tucked hands, the raised straight legs, whole body.

STANDING CALF RAISE on a stair edge at the top position. The athlete stands on the balls of his feet on the edge of a step/platform with heels raised high, one hand lightly touching a rail or wall for balance, ankles fully plantar-flexed, body upright. Side three-quarter view showing the raised heels off the step edge, the toes on the step, the hand support, whole body.

WEIGHTED COSSACK SQUAT at the bottom. The athlete holds a dumbbell vertically at the chest with both hands (goblet position), in a deep side lunge: right leg bent deeply with the foot flat, left leg straight out to the side with the toe pointing up and heel on the floor, torso upright. Front three-quarter view showing the bent right leg, the extended left leg, the chest-held weight, whole body and both feet.

MEDICINE BALL OVERHEAD SLAM at the top of the raise. The athlete stands in an athletic stance holding a large soft medicine ball with both hands fully overhead, arms extended, knees slightly bent ready to slam, torso tall. Front three-quarter view showing the ball above the head, both hands gripping it, whole body and both feet.

WORLD'S GREATEST STRETCH at the rotated position. The athlete is in a deep forward lunge with the right leg forward: right hand planted on the floor inside the right foot, torso rotated open to the right, left arm reaching straight up to the ceiling, back left knee low near the floor. Front three-quarter view showing the lunge, the planted right hand, the upward-reached left arm, the open rotated torso, whole body and both feet.

BAND Y-RAISE at the top. The athlete stands holding the ends of a looped resistance band anchored under the mid-foot, arms raised diagonally overhead in a Y shape with straight elbows and palms facing in, band under tension running from under the feet to both hands. Front three-quarter view showing the Y-shaped raised arms, the stretched band down to the feet, whole body.

BARBELL WIDE-STANCE SQUAT at the bottom. The athlete squats with the barbell resting on the upper back/traps, feet set well wider than shoulder width with toes angled out, hips sunk to parallel, knees pushed out over the toes, torso upright. Front three-quarter view showing the bar on the back, the wide stance, the depth, whole body and both feet.

KETTLEBELL ONE-ARM FLOOR PRESS at the lowered position. The athlete lies flat on his back on the floor with knees bent and feet flat, right hand gripping a kettlebell by the horns with the bell resting on the forearm, elbow bent and hovering just off the floor beside the ribs. Side three-quarter view showing the lying position, the kettlebell on the forearm, the bent elbow near the floor, whole body.
